calls.reconciliation: All three dossiers agree on the facts: guidance $89.85-90.95B, consensus ~$90.6-90.7B, the history of recent actuals, and no market found. The only dispute is judgment: which beat magnitude to apply and to which base. Run 2 applied ~1.9% to consensus; Runs 1 and 3 applied ~2.3-2.7% to the guidance midpoint. The guidance-midpoint beat record over FY25-FY26 averages ~2.5%, with Q1 FY26 and Q4 FY26 at ~3.2%. I adopted that base, which puts my median slightly above all three runs at $92.55B. I kept their dispersion of ~$2B and the 2%/3% escape masses. Nothing was retrieved on this run.
